conditions.WHERE: t_order_comment.wh_id IS NOT NULL AND t_order_comment.order_number IS NOT NULL

order_comment_summary.description: The 't_order_comment' table stores comments for each order, including header/footer indicator, comment type, sequence, and text. It joins to 't_order' on order_number and wh_id for retrieving full order context, useful for reporting or operational insights on order-specific comments.

JOIN: t_po_master ON t_unknown_po_order_labels.po_number = t_po_master.po_number
t_po_detail ON t_unknown_po_order_labels.po_number = t_po_detail.po_number
t_po_comment ON t_unknown_po_order_labels.po_number = t_po_comment.po_number
t_rcpt_ship_po ON t_unknown_po_order_labels.po_number = t_rcpt_ship_po.po_number
t_rcpt_ship_po_detail ON t_unknown_po_order_labels.po_number = t_rcpt_ship_po_detail.po_number
t_receipt ON t_unknown_po_order_labels.po_number = t_receipt.po_number
t_unknown_receipt ON t_unknown_po_order_labels.po_number = t_unknown_receipt.po_number
conditions.WHERE: t_unknown_po_order_labels.po_number IS NOT NULL

unknown_po_order_labels_summary.description: The 't_unknown_po_order_labels' table stores unknown purchase order labels, including label quantity and print date. It can join with PO master, PO detail, PO comment, receipt shipment, receipt shipment details, receipts, and unknown receipts via 'po_number' for tracking label generation, PO processing, and receipt reconciliation.

JOIN: t_order ON t_rds_tote_master.order_number = t_order.order_number
t_order_detail ON t_order.order_number = t_order_detail.order_number AND t_order.wh_id = t_order_detail.wh_id
t_order_comment ON t_rds_tote_master.order_number = t_order_comment.order_number
t_tran_log ON t_rds_tote_master.order_number = t_tran_log.control_number
conditions.WHERE: t_rds_tote_master.wh_id IS NOT NULL AND t_rds_tote_master.tote_id IS NOT NULL

rds_tote_master_summary.description: The 't_rds_tote_master' table tracks totes in the warehouse, including queue, status, and outbound zone. It joins with orders, order comments, and transaction logs using 'order_number' to monitor tote assignment, processing status, and related order information for warehouse operations.

conditions.WHERE: t_rds_tote_detail.wh_id IS NOT NULL AND t_rds_tote_detail.tote_id IS NOT NULL

rds_tote_detail_summary.description: The 't_rds_tote_detail' table stores detailed tote information including zone, line number, status, and status date. It joins with 't_rds_tote_master' for tote metadata and with orders, order comments, and transaction logs via 'order_number' to track tote processing and related order fulfillment in warehouse operations.

JOIN: t_order_detail ON t_order_airbag_price.item_number = t_order_detail.item_number
t_bom_detail ON t_order_airbag_price.item_number = t_bom_detail.item_number
t_stored_item ON t_order_airbag_price.item_number = t_stored_item.item_number
conditions.WHERE: t_order_airbag_price.item_number IS NOT NULL

order_airbag_price_summary.description: The 't_order_airbag_price' table stores pricing information for individual items. It joins with 't_order_detail' for order-level item information, 't_bom_detail' for kit/component breakdowns, and 't_stored_item' for inventory location and quantity details, enabling comprehensive cost analysis and inventory valuation in warehouse management and order processing systems.

conditions.WHERE: t_ml_resource.resource_id IS NOT NULL

ml_resource_summary.description: The 't_ml_resource' table stores multilingual resource strings, including the text and description for each resource ID and locale. It is used in applications for localization and internationalization, providing the appropriate language-specific text based on the locale. Currently, it does not directly join with other operational tables but can be linked via application resource IDs where needed.

JOIN: t_ml_resource ON t_ml_lookup.resource_id = t_ml_resource.resource_id
conditions.WHERE: t_ml_lookup.lookup_id IS NOT NULL

ml_lookup_summary.description: The 't_ml_lookup' table provides lookup mappings for multilingual resources. Each entry links a usage context and lookup ID to a specific resource_id in the 't_ml_resource' table, enabling the system to retrieve the appropriate localized text. This table is used in conjunction with 't_ml_resource' for translation and display purposes in the application.

conditions.WHERE: t_logsend.log_id IS NOT NULL

logsend_summary.description: The 't_logsend' table stores system or application logs with timestamp, log level, and detailed message. It is mainly used for monitoring, debugging, and auditing purposes. This table is independent and does not have direct foreign key relationships with operational tables like orders, warehouse, or inventory tables.

JOIN: t_stored_item ON t_hj_inventory_adjustment.wh_id = t_stored_item.wh_id AND t_hj_inventory_adjustment.item_number = t_stored_item.item_number AND t_hj_inventory_adjustment.lot_number = t_stored_item.lot_number AND t_hj_inventory_adjustment.fifo_date = t_stored_item.fifo_date
t_location ON t_hj_inventory_adjustment.wh_id = t_location.wh_id AND t_hj_inventory_adjustment.from_location_id = t_location.location_id
t_location AS to_location ON t_hj_inventory_adjustment.wh_id = to_location.wh_id AND t_hj_inventory_adjustment.to_location_id = to_location.location_id
conditions.WHERE: t_hj_inventory_adjustment.adjustment_id IS NOT NULL

hj_inventory_adjustment_summary.description: The 't_hj_inventory_adjustment' table records inventory adjustments in the warehouse. It includes quantities before and after adjustment, item details, locations, transaction codes, user info, and timestamps. It can be joined with stored items for detailed item info and locations for movement tracking.

JOIN: t_stored_item ON t_cycle_count_trigger.wh_id = t_stored_item.wh_id AND t_cycle_count_trigger.item_number = t_stored_item.item_number AND t_cycle_count_trigger.location_id = t_stored_item.location_id AND t_cycle_count_trigger.hu_id = t_stored_item.hu_id
t_location ON t_cycle_count_trigger.wh_id = t_location.wh_id AND t_cycle_count_trigger.location_id = t_location.location_id
t_hu_detail ON t_cycle_count_trigger.hu_id = t_hu_detail.hu_id
t_hu_master ON t_cycle_count_trigger.hu_id = t_hu_master.hu_id
t_tran_log ON t_cycle_count_trigger.hu_id = t_tran_log.hu_id
conditions.WHERE: t_cycle_count_trigger.trigger_id IS NOT NULL

cycle_count_trigger_summary.description: The 't_cycle_count_trigger' table records triggers for cycle counts in the warehouse. It tracks which items and locations need counting, the reason for triggering, the user, timestamps, and associated work queue info. It can be joined with stored items for inventory details and location table for location attributes.

JOIN: t_cycle_count_trigger ON t_cycle_count_approval.work_q_id = t_cycle_count_trigger.work_q_id AND t_cycle_count_approval.wh_id = t_cycle_count_trigger.wh_id

t_stored_item ON t_cycle_count_approval.wh_id = t_stored_item.wh_id AND t_cycle_count_approval.item_number = t_stored_item.item_number AND t_cycle_count_approval.location_id = t_stored_item.location_id
t_hu_master ON t_cycle_count_approval.hu_id = t_hu_master.hu_id
t_hu_detail ON t_cycle_count_approval.hu_id = t_hu_detail.hu_id
t_tran_log ON t_cycle_count_approval.hu_id = t_tran_log.hu_id
conditions.WHERE: t_cycle_count_approval.wh_id IS NOT NULL AND t_cycle_count_approval.location_id IS NOT NULL

cycle_count_approval_summary.description: The 't_cycle_count_approval' table stores cycle count approval records, including status, approval/rejection info, and related work queue. It joins with t_cycle_count_trigger for trigger info, t_stored_item for item-level inventory details, and HU tables (t_hu_master, t_hu_detail) along with t_tran_log for transaction history and auditing.

JOIN: t_pick_detail ON t_cut_hose.pick_id = t_pick_detail.pick_id AND t_cut_hose.location_id = t_pick_detail.pick_location
t_stored_item ON t_cut_hose.cut_hu_id = t_stored_item.hu_id AND t_cut_hose.location_id = t_stored_item.location_id
t_tran_log ON t_cut_hose.cut_hu_id = t_tran_log.hu_id
t_location ON t_cut_hose.location_id = t_location.location_id
conditions.WHERE: t_cut_hose.location_id IS NOT NULL AND t_cut_hose.cut_hu_id IS NOT NULL

cut_hose_summary.description: The 't_cut_hose' table tracks cut hose operations, including pick details, HU info, quantity, cut length, and status. It joins with t_pick_detail for pick-level info, t_stored_item for inventory HU details, t_tran_log for transaction history, and t_location for detailed warehouse location info (zone, type, capacity, etc.).

JOIN: t_location ON t_cut_hoseTEST.location_id = t_location.location_id
t_pick_detail ON t_cut_hoseTEST.pick_id = t_pick_detail.pick_id AND t_cut_hoseTEST.location_id = t_pick_detail.pick_location
t_stored_item ON t_cut_hoseTEST.cut_hu_id = t_stored_item.hu_id AND t_cut_hoseTEST.location_id = t_stored_item.location_id
t_tran_log ON t_cut_hoseTEST.cut_hu_id = t_tran_log.hu_id
conditions.WHERE: t_cut_hoseTEST.location_id IS NOT NULL AND t_cut_hoseTEST.cut_hu_id IS NOT NULL

cut_hose_test_summary.description: The 't_cut_hoseTEST' table tracks hose cutting operations including pick details, HU information, quantities, cut lengths, and status. It joins with t_location to get warehouse details, t_pick_detail for pick-level info, t_stored_item for inventory HU details, t_tran_log for transaction history, and lookup tables for additional metadata, enabling comprehensive WMS reporting and operational insights.

JOIN: t_order ON t_box_centres.order_number = t_order.order_number
t_hu_master ON t_box_centres.order_number = t_hu_master.control_number
t_tran_log ON t_box_centres.order_number = t_tran_log.control_number
conditions.WHERE: t_box_centres.order_number IS NOT NULL

box_centres_summary.description: The 't_box_centres' table stores box flag info per centre for specific orders, including type, start/end dates, and manifests. It joins with t_order, t_hu_master, and t_tran_log for order and HU details, and t_location, t_pick_detail, t_stored_item, t_fwd_pick, and lookup tables for warehouse and inventory context. This enables detailed tracking of box operations and reporting in WMS systems.

conditions.WHERE: staged_quantity > 0

staged_orders_count.description: Counts distinct orders that have at least one pick line with staged quantity greater than zero. Used to identify how many orders are currently staged in the picking workflow.

conditions.WHERE: t_pick_detail.pick_id IS NOT NULL AND t_pick_detail.order_number IS NOT NULL

order_status.description: The t_pick_detail table stores information about warehouse orders, including current status and staging location. It is used to determine how many orders are PICKED, STAGED, or LOADED and to track their progress through the warehouse.
